project.name: 学习路径 Fork 树状图
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 游戏化学习应用，蓝白清新学院风，fork 树状图展示分支与回归循环
project.designRead: component UI / students / playful-game / medium density / avoid neon glow

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: primary blue #4F7DF7 for main path and key interactions
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single primary hue with purple fork accent and amber return accent for path differentiation
colorSystem.stateColors: success green, warning amber, error red

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: rounded cards (10-14px radius), pill badges, organic curved SVG connectors
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + PingFang SC, clean hierarchy, medium weight contrast
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px base, generous card padding (16-24px), comfortable node spacing
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: rounded cards with subtle border, pill badges, inline SVG tree connectors
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: white cards on light gray bg, subtle border-led surfaces, no deep shadows on static elements
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: minimal icons inline, game-style badges and checkpoint markers

designSource.designDecisionSummary: 蓝白清新学院风游戏化学习应用，单页组件聚焦 Fork 树状图可视化

pages.title: 学习路径 Fork 树状图
pages.businessScenario: 学习路径 Fork 机制可视化
pages.visualNorthStar: A game-style fork tree diagram that makes the learning path's branching-and-returning loop immediately intuitive, with organic curved connectors and badge-styled nodes
pages.compositionPattern: centered single-focus component with supporting context
